name: NA Frame Counter
description: Live NaN GD-inspired frame window counter measuring click and release survival windows at 240Hz, with outlined world markers, pitch-mapped ding audio, and live NaNDL precision.

open-mod-menu.name: Customize NA Frame Counter
open-mod-menu.description: Open the interactive in-game customization menu with tabs for engine, circle visuals, ding pitch audio, and NaNDL precision.

open-menu-keybind.name: Open Mod Menu Keybind
open-menu-keybind.description: Keybind to open or close the NA Frame Counter customization menu.

enabled.name: Enable Mod
enabled.description: Master switch for live frame window measuring, HUD overlays, markers, and audio.

measure-clicks.name: Measure Click Windows
measure-clicks.description: Calculate live 240Hz survival windows for button presses (clicks).

measure-releases.name: Measure Release Windows
measure-releases.description: Calculate live 240Hz survival windows for button releases (Wave, Ship, Robot, and tight Cube releases).

maximum-window-frames.name: Maximum Window (Frames)
maximum-window-frames.description: Maximum survival window width (in 240Hz frames) measured around each input (10 matches NaNDL website).

ignore-harmless-clicks.name: Ignore Non-Fatal Clicks
ignore-harmless-clicks.description: Skip clicks where removing the input does not change survival (e.g. harmless mid-air clicks).

show-over-limit.name: Show Over-Limit Inputs
show-over-limit.description: Display a >Max badge when an input survives beyond the configured maximum window.

show-rings.name: Show Circle Markers
show-rings.description: Highlight click and release locations with an outlined circle and frame count number.

label-placement.name: Frame Number Placement
label-placement.description: Where the frame count number (e.g. '1') appears relative to the outlined circle.

color-preset.name: Color Palette
color-preset.description: Color progression for frame window tiers (1 frame tightest up to wide windows).

color-1f.name: 1-Frame Color (Custom)
color-1f.description: Custom RGB color for 1-frame perfects when Color Palette is set to 'Custom 1-5+'.

color-2f.name: 2-Frame Color (Custom)
color-2f.description: Custom RGB color for 2-frame windows when Color Palette is set to 'Custom 1-5+'.

color-3f.name: 3-Frame Color (Custom)
color-3f.description: Custom RGB color for 3-frame windows when Color Palette is set to 'Custom 1-5+'.

color-4f.name: 4-Frame Color (Custom)
color-4f.description: Custom RGB color for 4-frame windows when Color Palette is set to 'Custom 1-5+'.

color-5p.name: 5+ Frame Color (Custom)
color-5p.description: Custom RGB color for 5+ frame windows when Color Palette is set to 'Custom 1-5+'.

circle-radius.name: Circle Radius
circle-radius.description: Radius (in screen points) of the click/release highlight circle.

circle-thickness.name: Circle Thickness
circle-thickness.description: Stroke width of the colored circle ring.

marker-scale.name: Marker & Text Scale
marker-scale.description: Overall scale multiplier for circle markers and numbers.

marker-fade-seconds.name: Marker Fade Duration (s)
marker-fade-seconds.description: Seconds before markers fade out (0 = keep visible until death or restart).

scale-with-zoom.name: Scale Markers With Zoom
scale-with-zoom.description: Scale world markers proportionally with level camera zoom.

distinguish-release.name: Tag Release Markers (R)
distinguish-release.description: Prefix release window numbers with 'R' (e.g. R1) so release timings stand out from clicks.

ding-sounds.name: Enable Ding Sounds
ding-sounds.description: Play a pitch-mapped ding sound for measured frame windows (lower pitch for tighter windows, higher pitch for wider windows).

sound-style.name: Ding Sound Style
sound-style.description: Select one of the built-in ding tones or use a custom audio file.

custom-sound-file.name: Custom Sound File
custom-sound-file.description: Custom .wav/.mp3/.ogg file used when Ding Sound Style is set to 'Custom File'.

sound-volume.name: Ding Volume
sound-volume.description: Volume of frame window ding sounds.

sync-gd-sfx.name: Scale With GD SFX Volume
sync-gd-sfx.description: Multiply ding volume by Geometry Dash's master SFX volume slider.

min-pitch.name: Lowest Pitch (1 Frame)
min-pitch.description: Pitch multiplier for 1-frame perfects (lower = deeper ding).

max-pitch.name: Highest Pitch (Wide Window)
max-pitch.description: Pitch multiplier at the upper end of the audio pitch scale (higher = brighter ding).

pitch-curve.name: Pitch Mapping Curve
pitch-curve.description: How frame window size maps from Lowest Pitch (1F) to Highest Pitch.

sound-max-frames.name: Audio Max Window Threshold
sound-max-frames.description: Only play ding sounds for windows at or below this frame count.

show-counters.name: Show Frame Window Tally HUD
show-counters.description: Display live counts per frame window tier on screen.

hud-corner.name: Tally HUD Corner
hud-corner.description: Screen corner where the frame window tally list is anchored.

bucket-order.name: Tally Bucket Order
bucket-order.description: Order of frame tiers in the tally list ('1 at Bottom' matches classic NaN GD).

show-last-badge.name: Show Last Input Indicator
show-last-badge.description: Show a compact readout of the most recent measured click or release window.

show-precision-hud.name: Show Live NaNDL Precision (L*)
show-precision-hud.description: Display live NaNDL sigma/s (L*) precision in the bottom-left corner.

nandl-model.name: NaNDL Precision Model
nandl-model.description: Which NaNDL difficulty weighting model(s) to display in the precision HUD.

nandl-show-base.name: Custom HUD: Base L*
nandl-show-base.description: Show Base model L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

nandl-show-nerve.name: Custom HUD: Nerve L*
nandl-show-nerve.description: Show Nerve model L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

nandl-show-fatigue.name: Custom HUD: Fatigue L*
nandl-show-fatigue.description: Show Fatigue model L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

nandl-show-cps.name: Custom HUD: CPS L*
nandl-show-cps.description: Show CPS model L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

nandl-show-nf.name: Custom HUD: Nerve+Fatigue L*
nandl-show-nf.description: Show Nerve+Fatigue model L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

nandl-show-nc.name: Custom HUD: Nerve+CPS L*
nandl-show-nc.description: Show Nerve+CPS model L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

nandl-show-fc.name: Custom HUD: Fatigue+CPS L*
nandl-show-fc.description: Show Fatigue+CPS model L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

nandl-show-nfc.name: Custom HUD: NFC (Full) L*
nandl-show-nfc.description: Show full Nerve+Fatigue+CPS L* when NaNDL Precision Model is set to 'Custom Toggles'.

show-pass-prob.name: Show Pass Probability P(C)
show-pass-prob.description: Also show estimated clear probability at the solved L* inside the precision HUD.

show-expected-time.name: Show Expected Attempt Time E[Ta]
show-expected-time.description: Show expected attempt survival time E[Ta] alongside L* inside the precision HUD.

macro-fps.name: NaNDL Window FPS
macro-fps.description: Denominator FPS used in NaNDL w_i = N_i / FPS (240.0 standard for GD 2.2).

respawn-time.name: NaNDL Respawn Time (s)
respawn-time.description: Respawn delay added to every input timestamp t_i in NaNDL calculations.

target-hours.name: NaNDL Target Clear Time (Hours)
target-hours.description: Expected clear time E[Tc] solved for L* (24.0 hours is the NaNDL standard).
